purpose: corpus-swap-spatial-coverage — the post-swap 100-id benchmark corpus, distinguishable from the original corpus-resample-100-with-frame draw (eval/frame/drawn_slice_data.cityofnewyork.us_2026-08-17.json) and from the swap bookkeeping (spatial_swap_finalized_2026-08-17.json). This file's `corpus_ids` is the definitive post-swap id list for any downstream tool (generate_queries.py, judge_qrels.py) — NOT the whole auctus_catalog_master index, which also holds 44 pre-existing legacy datasets and 16 stray ingested-but-unused candidates untouched by this change.
derivation: corpus_ids = (original 100-id draw - 18 removed_ids) | 18 verified_ids, per spatial_swap_finalized_2026-08-17.json

live_index_accounting.note: the 16 strays recorded below were deleted after author review; index is now exactly corpus + legacy

strays_not_in_corpus.note: left in auctus_catalog_master untouched by this change; not part of the benchmark corpus; naming them here so a future whole-index sweep (e.g. build_corpus_slice.py, which scrolls the entire index) does not silently treat them as corpus members
strays_not_in_corpus.rejected_preflight_reason: all three LLM-backed arms failed at ingestion — oversized WKT geometry field (~2.04M tokens) exceeded the model's 1,048,576-token limit; the same failure shape as c5vm-g2dk. Root cause is an unguarded sample passed to attach_autoddg_description (storage/arq_worker.py); a separate change addresses it.
strays_not_in_corpus.status: DELETED from auctus_catalog_master on author instruction, same session, after this file was written. auctus_catalog_master post-cleanup: 144 = 100 corpus + 44 legacy, 0 strays.

temporal_bounds_check_6_1.scope: 18 swap-in datasets only (fresh ingestion; the prior round's check on the original 100 does not carry over)
temporal_bounds_check_6_1.result: 11/18 carry a DateTime-semantic column; 11/11 of those produce a real numeric-POSIX interval via storage.arq_worker._temporal_interval; 0 bug cases (DateTime column present but interval null). The numeric-bounds bug did not reproduce.
